description: Rank every Polymarket wallet with your own composite — exactly what the Ranking Builder runs (POST /v1/rankings/custom). weights: metric id → weight (or {weight, window}); any of the 84 catalog metrics at any window it exists at (polyrank_get_metric_windows), plus copy-engine (sk_score_14d) and entry-timing ids at lifetime. filters: min_trades, min_resolved, min_volume_usdc, min_realized_pnl(_net_fees), min_win_rate_pct, max_roi_pct, active_within_days/hours, categories, exclude_bonders, skill_gates [{metric,min_pctile,window}], metric_filters [{metric,min,max,window}], copy_engine {sleeve}, timing {sub,bucket,window,min_n}, cluster_policy, copy_placeable, smart_money_tags_any_of, follower_count_max … (the server rejects anything it cannot apply, with the reason). as_of=YYYY-MM-DD ranks the board as it stood that day (lifetime snapshot metrics only — refused with the reason otherwise, never answered live). To reproduce a Builder goal, pass its `request` from polyrank_list_ranking_templates as `request`. Needs POLYRANK_API_KEY (a plan with the Builder).

as_of.description: Rank the board as it stood on this day (ISO date). Lifetime snapshot metrics only.

dedupe_clusters.description: Keep one wallet per wallet-farm cluster.

explain.description: How many wallets each filter dropped.

include_raw.description: Raw values beside the percentiles (dollars, hours).

include_verdict.description: The copy verdict the trader page shows.

request.description: A complete POST /v1/rankings/custom body (e.g. a goal's `request`). When given, the other arguments override its fields.

sort_by.description: composite (default), metric:<id>, pctile:<id>, engine:<id>, timing:<id>, or a board column.

weights.description: metric id → weight, or → {weight, window}. Weights are auto-normalized.

window.description: Default window for every weight given as a bare number (default lifetime).

name: polyrank_rank_wallets
title: Polyrank Ranking Builder (custom composite ranking)
